University of Education (UE) Status: Public vs Private
University of Education (UE) is a PUBLIC SECTOR (Government) research university located in Punjab, Pakistan.
• Status: Public (Government Chartered University).
• Established: 2002 by the Government of Punjab through the University of Education Ordinance.
• Recognition: HEC-recognized, public sector degree-awarding university offering subsidized government tuition fees.

University of Education Campuses & Jauharabad Campus:
University of Education is a multi-campus public university operating 9+ campuses across Punjab:
1. UE Jauharabad Campus: Established in Jauharabad (District Khushab, Punjab). Offers undergraduate & graduate programs in Computing (BS Computer Science / BSCS, BSIT, BSSE), Natural Sciences (Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Zoology, Botany), and Education/B.Ed.
2. Main Campus Township, Lahore (Division of Science & Technology)
3. Lower Mall Campus, Lahore
4. Bank Road Campus, Lahore (for female education)
5. Multan Campus (Bosan Road)
6. Faisalabad Campus (Samanabad)
7. Attock Campus
8. Dera Ghazi Khan (DG Khan) Campus
9. Vehari Campus

5. Scholarships
Merit Scholarship
Awarded to the top 5% of students in each program by aggregate. Covers 50% of tuition fee.
Renewed each semester, contingent on maintaining a CGPA of 3.5 or above.
Need-Based Scholarship
Available to students with documented household income below PKR 60,000/month. Covers up to
100% of tuition fee, based on a review of submitted income and utility bill proof. Renewed annually.
Sports Scholarship

Sports Scholarship
For students with a national or provincial-level sports achievement. Covers 25–50% of tuition fee,
subject to trial evaluation by the sports department.
Sibling Discount
A 10% tuition discount applies when a sibling is concurrently enrolled at University of Education in any program.

11. Frequently Asked Questions
Q: Is the entry test compulsory for all programs?
A: Yes, the University Admission Test (UE-HAT) is mandatory for all undergraduate applicants, except
candidates with a top-3 board position, who may receive a waiver.
Q: Can I apply for more than one program?
A: Yes, applicants may select up to two programs in order of preference on a single application.
Q: Is hostel accommodation available?

A: No, University of Education currently offers only regular morning-shift programs.
Q: How can I check my admission status?
A: Applicants can track their status anytime via the University of Education admissions portal using their application ID.
Q: Is the security deposit refundable?
A: Yes, the security deposit is refunded upon graduation or withdrawal, after deduction of any
outstanding dues.

Q: Is hostel accommodation available?
A: Yes, separate hostels for male and female students are available on a first-come-first-served
basis. Hostel fee is charged separately from tuition.
Q: What is the medium of instruction?
A: English is the medium of instruction, with orientation-week material also available in Urdu for
first-semester students.
Q: Are evening or weekend programs available?
A: No, University of Education currently offers only regular morning-shift programs.
